pages.text: Every unit, player and creature has SC2 $(l)attributes$(): light, armored, biological, mechanical, psionic, massive, structure, heroic, detector. You are biological, light and heroic. Weapons do bonus damage against some: a marauder +10 to armored, an adept +12 to light, an archon +10 to biological, a corruptor +6 to massive.

Brew from an awkward potion: $(l)light$() (a feather, faster), $(l)armored$() (an iron ingot, +4 armor), $(l)biological$() (rotten flesh), $(l)mechanical$() (a copper ingot, +2 armor), $(l)psionic$() (an amethyst shard), $(l)massive$() (obsidian: no knockback, more health, walks through force fields and shatters them), $(l)detector$() (an ender eye: sees cloaked units), $(l)radar$() (a glow ink sac: sees creatures through walls within 48 blocks).

Redstone makes a potion last 8 minutes instead of 3; gunpowder makes it a splash potion, dragon's breath a lingering one. Thrown, they take on players, creatures and units, never on buildings. A terran $(l)sensor tower$() shows its player everything that moves within 30 SC2 units, through walls.
